input: Find day (only those in Travelers Rest, Landrum or Cleveland, SC) summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near upstate South Carolina near the NC line (Travelers Rest, Cleveland, Marietta, Landrum, Greer, Greenville and Spartanburg). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Valley Forest School
candidates.note: Outdoor summer day camps; Travelers Rest programs were offered in 2026.

candidates.name: Kids Camp Landrum
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camp with themed activities, puzzles, games, field trips and devotions.

candidates.name: TR Makers Co.
candidates.note: Summer Maker Days and camps with hands-on art and crafting; 2025 programs confirmed.

candidates.name: Shipshape Farm
candidates.note: Drop-off farm camps with animal care, gardening, outdoor games and creative projects; ran in 2025 and 2026.

candidates.name: YMCA of Greenville
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camp through the George I. Theisen Family YMCA in Travelers Rest.

candidates.name: Sunshine House
candidates.note: School-age summer day camp for ages 5–12; Travelers Rest is an advertised camp location.

candidates.name: The Well Church of Landrum
candidates.note: 2025 evening Vacation Bible School for ages 3 through completed fifth grade.

candidates.name: Renfrew Church of Travelers Rest
candidates.note: Illumination Station Vacation Bible School ran June 7–11, 2026, in the evenings.

candidates.name: Foothills Baptist Church of Travelers Rest
candidates.note: Summer Vacation Bible School found for July 2025 and July 12–16, 2026.

candidates.name: Hilltop Church of Travelers Rest
candidates.note: Rainforest Falls Vacation Bible School began June 8, 2026, with evening sessions.

candidates.name: Trailside Church of Travelers Rest
candidates.note: Three-evening summer VBS for rising K4–fifth grade, with games, music, crafts and Bible stories.
